_comment: Editorial overlay for data/games.json — display order, website-voice taglines, and what to badge as new. Hand-maintained: this is the marketing voice, which deliberately does not live in the app's presets. Keyed by page slug (a game's slug, or its family's when variants share a page). build.mjs fails if games.json contains a game this file does not mention, so a new release cannot silently drop off the site.

entries.tagline: Eight cells, and room to think
Lift a card, buried and all
Build each suit from both ends
Count by one, two, three, four
